action: Complete the demographic and referral fields of the Maternal Admission Record (MAR) at clerking, including referral type and referring facility for every referred mother.
Transcribe ANC history, supplements and test results from the mother's ANC booklet at admission; record 'Not done' explicitly when a test was not done.
Record a full set of triage vital signs and danger signs (BP, heart rate, temperature, respiratory rate, SpO2, foetal heart rate) for every mother at admission.
Document stage of labour on admission and, after delivery, mode of delivery, CS type, indication and the decision and delivery times.
Tick delivery complications in the admission diagnosis, or tick 'None' so that absence is documented.
Record postpartum bleeding and estimated blood loss for every delivery.
Complete the maternal discharge summary, including outcome, for every mother before the file leaves the ward.
